mutations.label: RFA the `max(0, ...)` becomes a bare subtraction, so a VANISHED hit subtracts from the new count and a run that fixes one shape while introducing another nets to ZERO new -- the monitor reports 'nothing new' on the one run that matters.
mutations.find: new = sum(max(0, c - base.get(k, 0)) for k, c in seen.items())
mutations.replace: new = sum(c - base.get(k, 0) for k, c in seen.items())

mutations.label: RFB the baseline is compared on KEY PRESENCE instead of count, so a second hit under an existing label is invisible: run_budget.py already holds two `usd` candidates, and a third would be swallowed. This is why the baseline stores counts.
mutations.find: new = sum(max(0, c - base.get(k, 0)) for k, c in seen.items())
mutations.replace: new = sum(1 for k in seen if k not in base)

mutations.label: RFC vanished baseline hits stop being reported, so a detector that has DRIFTED (or a shape someone fixed) both read as a clean run. #1202jn's repair made D6 go quiet on purpose, so going quiet is information, not silence.
mutations.find: gone = {k: base[k] - seen.get(k, 0) for k in base if base[k] > seen.get(k, 0)}

mutations.label: RFD CONTROL, expected CAUGHT: the key drops the label and keys on the filename alone, so every hit in one file collapses into one bucket and a NEW shape in an already-flagged file never registers.
